final.memo:
We entered this position to exploit a controversy-driven discount and the technical dynamics of a crowded short [D01]. The stock has since repriced from our entry in the low $30s, and the technical catalyst associated with the short squeeze has played out [D01, D04]. 

While the company reported strong Q4 results, we are not in the business of winning arguments [D01]. These results demonstrate growth but do not resolve the underlying legal and business-model criticisms, nor do they turn a volatile, regulatory-sensitive asset into a low-risk staple [D01, D03]. 

We value our capital and recognize that an E2 technical event, once exhausted, no longer justifies the risk of holding through unresolved regulatory clouds [D01, D05]. We are exiting the position to rotate into higher-skew events where our edge is clearer and the path to IRR is not dependent on the outcome of a public debate [D01].
